interpretation.aliases: Every registered alias is retained as a separate handler. Identical method/path can differ by query, rank or registration condition.
interpretation.basepath: All mounts are additionally prefixed by CONFIG.domain_path(). Listed URIs use an empty domain path; mount/relative_uri preserve the exact declarations.
interpretation.conditions: conditions_any_of is disjunctive normal form: any inner list may hold, and all expressions within that list must hold. [[]] means unconditional.
interpretation.count: Union of declared route handlers across build/config variants, not simultaneous distinct HTTP endpoints.
interpretation.family: family is a derived organizational label; by_source_module records the unambiguous upstream source-module counts.
interpretation.implicit_framework_behavior: Automatic HEAD fallback for GET and CORS fairing OPTIONS are framework behavior, not extra declared route handlers.
interpretation.rank: null means Rocket derives its default rank from the path/query; numeric values are explicit.
